description: the live tape: the latest buys and sells by tracked traders (fomo and pump.fun), newest first. to follow a watchlist, pass traders (up to 25 handles) and the cursor of the previous call as since, once a minute: one call returns every new trade of those traders, instead of reading each profile. also side buy or sell, min_usd.

limit.description: rows to return, default 30. ask for fewer to get a shorter answer

since.description: iso time, e.g. the cursor from the previous call

traders.description: only these traders: handles from search or the leaderboard, up to 25

name: get_live_trades
title: live trades tape
